messages:
jamal: FYI — AcmeCorp raised a ticket: usage analytics missing ~6h on console. Gap from 2026-02-10 03:00 to 09:00 UTC. They sent a screenshot. Can we triage?

maria: thanks — any job ids or trace?

jamal: attaching collector logs:
```
[2026-02-10T03:15:02Z] usage-collector-prod ERROR: ETL batch failed: deadline exceeded while reading from s3://usage-raw/2026-02-10/03/*
[2026-02-10T03:15:02Z] usage-collector-prod ERROR: retry exhausted
```

sam: looks like S3 read timeouts spiking in that window. Also seeing spike in sqs backlog for usage-queue. checking infra metrics.

infra-bot: Alert: S3ReadErrors >= 5/min on bucket usage-raw (03:10-03:25 UTC)

ops-anna: @sam @maria assigning to eng-infra oncall. I'll also check whether backfill already started.

maria: quick repro query against warehouse:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acmecorp' AND ts >= '2026-02-10 03:00:00' AND ts < '2026-02-10 09:00:00';
```
Result returned zero rows.

jamal: customer reports they continued to hit API and have logs with tokens, so events were emitted. Likely ETL ingestion lost them.

sam: confirmed SQS visibility timeout errors around 03:12->03:20, many messages moved to DLQ. Possible transient permission issue with worker role accessing S3 multipart. Raising IR ticket.

maria: can we backfill from raw & DLQ? what are the backfill steps? :eyes:

ops-anna: I'll run safe backfill for that window now (dry-run first). command:
```
./scripts/backfill_usage.sh --start '2026-02-10T03:00' --end '2026-02-10T09:00' --account acmecorp --dry-run
```

jamal: awesome — please post when started. I'll reply to the customer and keep them updated.

ops-anna: dry-run completed, found ~12k messages in DLQ for acmecorp. proceeding with live backfill in 5m, will monitor dashboards and POST status here. :rocket:

maria: thanks — once done, we'll re-run the dashboard ingest and confirm metrics appear. if backfill fails we may need infra rollback.

ops-anna: backfill started (1782005678). will update with completion time.

support-bot: Ticket #12345 updated: scheduled backfill initiated by ops-anna.

jamal: noted. Keeping customer informed. :thumbsup:
